description: Search frozen pathway identifiers by literal substring (spaces become underscores). Returns all FGSEA variants and BOTH CAMERA settings where tested, including nonsignificant results. Returns all matching pathways by default; optional limit and offset select a smaller set. Not independent replication.

limit.description: Omit or use all for every match. A positive integer requests an optional smaller result set.
